scope.edition_relationship: alternate readings of one manuscript, not independent witnesses

native_provenance.native_view: full original, default then original detail; no crops, rotations, OCR or enhancement
native_provenance.certainty: 28-entry cyclic layout compatible with catalogue; moderate source-assisted locus attribution
native_provenance.boundary: Radial inscription entries separated from enclosing circular writing; no visible image-edge truncation. Internal word boundaries and glyph alternatives remain as supplied.
native_provenance.exposure: Initial native layout view preceded positional and literal ID queries. Catalogue clock positions assisted attribution. One guarded f69v-wide query additionally exposed three enclosing circular-text records, excluded here. Source Cisiojanus cell values were not supplied to observer A.

order.evidence: catalogue-assisted native-position-compatible order; not a fully independent glyph-to-locus certificate
order.proof_use: Repeated complete-entry equality does not depend on this order.
